scope: Proposition 4.1 (Moment recursion) of the manuscript “The Reconstruction Threshold for the Ferromagnetic Four-State Potts Model” (preprints/The-Reconstruction-Threshold-for-the-Ferromagnetic-Four-State-Potts-Model-October-5-2026/four-state-potts.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 229 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a8e3ff75c819ee34), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In either tree family of Theorem 1.1, the posterior law µn is symmetric and satisfies R H dµn ≥ 0 for every n ≥ 0. Let D denote the offspring count, so D = d on the regular tree and D has law Poisson(d) on the Galton–Watson tree. Then mn+1 ≤ dλ2 mn − 2 1000 Pr(D ≥ 2)(λ2 mn)3 . (4.4)
